contracts.exception: No backend is available for this prototype; submit stores validated data in Zustand and invokes a country-aware local quote mock that returns a simple greeting.

acceptanceCriteria: At desktop 1280px, the Chile root renders shared chrome once, the Home quote title, the centered 560px form card without the promotion, and the FAQ link.
At mobile 375px, the page uses 24px gutters, one column, no horizontal overflow, a responsive card/dialog, and a non-sticky CTA.
Submitting incomplete or malformed Chile fields focuses the first invalid control and shows the exact Figma field and general validation copy while keeping the CTA available.
Valid Chile values are normalized for RUT, local YYYY-MM-DD birth date, lowercase email, +569XXXXXXXX phone, required consent, and optional advisor code.
Customers younger than 18 receive the approved underage warning; there is no maximum-age rejection.
Advisor assistance reveals a locally validated 1-8 character alphanumeric code and tooltip, and disabling assistance clears the code.
A valid local submit stores the normalized Chile payload only in memory, shows Button loading/disabled while pending, and displays Hola Chile without HTTP traffic.
The shared local quote behavior displays Hola Colombia for co and Hola Perú for pe without collecting or passing Chilean PII.
Más información opens the approved two-tab Dialog and supports close control, backdrop, Escape, focus trapping/restoration, keyboard tabs, and internal scrolling.
No PII is written to Web Storage, logs, analytics, URLs, quote mock inputs, screenshots, or snapshots.
Automated checks and Playwright CLI evidence cover Chile validation/advisor/dialog/loading/success, Colombia/Peru success, desktop, and mobile states.
